verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a first-party "Bulk Mutate a List of Issues" API endpoint, so programmatic bulk changes across many issues are its own capability. The public API is backed by an official OpenAPI spec, which makes it usable by agents. But the evidence is only an endpoint title: it does not show which fields can be changed in bulk, any limits, or bulk support beyond issues. missing for 10: documented details of which fields and actions can be bulk-mutated, bulk operations exposed through the MCP server or CLI for agent workflows, bulk support for other item types (releases, projects, alerts), independent or hands-on corroboration.
